hours_kind: estimates across preserved October30-November11 assignments plus revised November12-17 plan; not measured effort

capacity_note: Critical path: Sudhansh12 common controls/scaffold; Likhit13 corpus and A/B/C representations; Gowtham14 full UI/loaders/runner/real capacity; Ujjwal15 independent input approval/freeze and full job launch; Pavan16 metrics/report/six slides/independent audit; Sudhansh17 clean release and submission. The58h estimate does not guarantee full scope fits.

days.title: Choose one runnable implementation
days.why: The remote prototype has a UI, while the local branch has reusable modules. Select one integration route before changing either version.
days.need: The two inspected revisions, supplied proposal and current course requirements.
steps: Keep the existing Chroma, MiniLM and Gradio route. Select one Apple 10-K with comparative years; record a minimal scope and launch path.
Define the evidence record and answer status fields. Record which UI functions and local modules will be reused in the integration branch.
Create the acceptance checklist and a shared handoff file. Record the official delivery requirements, model-access assumption and November 17 cutoff.
days.done: One integration checklist, one proposed filing, shared record examples and a fixed delivery checklist are saved.
days.learn: The goal is to repair a small existing prototype and prove its answers, rather than start another implementation.

days.title: Make setup and launch reproducible
days.why: The next owners need a working environment and a single application entry point. Repair setup before spending time on model or retrieval changes.
days.need: The Day 1 integration checklist and evidence examples.
steps: Review the previous handoff. Create the integration branch and port the chosen UI and module wiring without deleting the useful source versions.
Fix dependencies, including Gradio, and add one configuration loader and environment example. Keep credentials out of files and logs.
Run the existing lightweight tests and launch the UI in an explicit not-ready state. Document installation, data location and launch commands.
days.done: The application starts from documented commands, reports missing data clearly and has a saved setup and test log.
days.learn: A launchable application needs its dependencies, configuration and entry point to agree.

days.title: Connect a real model and remove false success
days.why: A fixed mock answer must never appear as financial analysis when the actual provider fails.
days.need: The configured application and status contract from Days 1 and 2.
steps: Verify one real provider and model on the demo machine. Put the confirmed model identifier in configuration and construct an explicit API client.
Remove automatic mock fallback and process-wide credential mutation. Keep mock mode available only through an explicit test setting.
Return service_error for provider failures and insufficient_evidence when context is absent. Save one real-call check and one deliberate failure check.
days.done: A real model call works; invalid credentials and empty evidence cannot return the fixed mock financial answer.
days.learn: Model access failure and missing source evidence are different outcomes and must remain visible.

days.title: Parse one supported annual report
days.why: One fully checked filing is a feasible foundation for the reduced schedule. Downloaded files alone are not searchable evidence.
days.need: The filing choice, evidence schema and data path already recorded.
steps: Record the exact accession, company, report fiscal year, original URL, local path and checksum for one Apple 10-K.
Move the required parsing cells into a repeatable function. Extract bounded sections from Items 1A, 7 and 8 and relevant statement tables.
Emit narrative and table records separately, preserving source locations, table titles, comparative periods and declared units. Save a parsing summary.
days.done: One command parses the declared filing into traceable narrative and table records; the table of contents is not treated as risk-factor evidence.
days.learn: The filing year and the comparative year of a table value are separate pieces of metadata.

days.title: Verify environment resources and handoff contracts
days.steps: Read current main and parser PR #4 at its exact revision; preserve completed setup/provider/parser work. Check BGE, exact FAISS, Docling, Ollama/Gemma, memory and machine access. Pin the canonical record/parent-table and index-sidecar contracts. Set up local DVC and MLflow with one restore/log smoke check and retain existing Ruff/pytest CI. Estimate full evaluation machine time from a small representative pilot or explicitly mark missing inputs.
days.done: Environment/resource inventory, input revision, canonical schema, successful DVC restore and MLflow smoke run exist. No model, parser or full-data readiness is inferred from installation alone.
days.course_concept: Reproducible AI and typed evidence contracts
dependency_dates: historical parser/provider handoffs at inspected revisions

days.title: Extend verified parsing to cells PDFs and chart sources
days.steps: Consume the tested Apple 2021 HTML parser rather than rebuilding its completed work. Add self-describing table cells and parent grids with raw/normalized units, periods, footnotes and source coordinates. Add Docling PDF extraction on checked fixtures and original chart image locators. Expand the initial Apple/Microsoft manifest and record unsupported layouts and chart availability. Distinguish HTML/PDF renditions and avoid duplicate fact ingestion.
days.done: Checked HTML/PDF cell fixtures, full parent tables, image/source manifests and deterministic records have resolvable provenance. Existing 316 narratives and three parent tables remain a preserved starting artifact, not final corpus coverage.
days.course_concept: KR ontology and grounded chart evidence

days.title: Independently validate canonical data and restore behavior
days.steps: Check representative source facts, periods, scales, parent links and deterministic IDs from the prior package. Validate row-to-ID mappings, metadata sidecars and a clean DVC restore with equal hashes. Retain any existing Chroma/MiniLM regression artifacts separately. Pin environment/configuration and validate storage replacement rules before the BGE/FAISS build.
days.done: One canonical data package and restore log reproduce the same IDs, hashes and counts; malformed or mismatched metadata fails. This is input validation, not a claim that FAISS is complete.

days.title: Build BGE exact FAISS and corpus coverage
days.steps: Use bge-base-en-v1.5 with pinned preprocessing/revision and normalized 768-dimensional vectors. Build exact IndexFlatIP with stable evidence/metadata mapping, separate parent-table storage and compatible manifests. Verify duplicate IDs, dimensions, filtered results, stale-record cleanup, rebuild and reload. Continue corpus expansion toward five Apple/five Microsoft filings and ten technology companies; show actual parsed/indexed counts and failures.
days.done: Checked narrative and cell retrieval survive restart and identical reruns. Source/index hashes and required company/filing coverage reconcile. IVF-PQ is not a release requirement.

days.title: Implement cumulative retrieval stages and routing
days.steps: Use the frozen record/index interfaces. Implement A-F flags for section chunks, table cells/parent expansion, BM25 and RRF k=60, eligibility and bge-reranker-base, and bounded narrative/numerical/chart routing. Keep the chart tier unavailable until descriptions exist. Preserve component ranks, IDs and complete evidence under the common budget. Use existing LangChain where it participates usefully; do not require a framework rewrite.
days.done: A-F traces isolate each stage; exact-term, semantic, TOC, no-result, missing-metric and context-budget cases pass with preserved IDs. Disabled streams issue no query.
days.course_concept: DL cross-encoding with explicit reasoning preconditions

days.title: Integrate real models calculations and chart descriptions
days.steps: Reuse merged provider boundaries and pin a real Gemma 3/Ollama configuration. Implement restricted multi-step arithmetic with cited operands and typed period/unit/comparability rules. Produce source-linked chart descriptions, unknown-value handling and a candidate 50-question chart set with 15 development and 35 held-out items grouped by image. Record the separate Llama comparison configuration and remaining hardware limits.
days.done: Real model and failure traces, safe calculation/rule fixtures, linked chart captions and candidate chart questions exist. No arbitrary generated Python executes, and unreadable chart values stay unknown.
days.course_concept: KR predicates and inference plus NLP and vision transformers

days.title: Connect the full interface and measure real throughput
days.steps: Connect Gradio to real narrative/cell/chart retrieval, calculations, route traces and source links. Check session isolation and explicit invalid/not-ready/no-evidence/service-error states. Run separate development smoke cases. Measure actual model, extraction/caption and evaluator throughput on intended hardware; pass the measurements to Sudhansh for the full-run estimate.
days.done: A notebook-free question-to-source walkthrough works for narrative, numerical and chart evidence with honest failures; real timing and memory evidence are saved.

days.title: Define full evaluation research question and capacity gate
days.steps: Build versioned FinQA, TAT-QA and FinanceBench loaders and A-G runner with source-equivalent evidence mappings, no label leakage and all promised metrics. Freeze dataset eligibility and proposed splits; preserve 14 local cases only as smoke tests. Consolidate chart labels, research question, report/course sections and role records. Estimate full machine hours using actual case counts and measured generation/RAGAS throughput.
days.done: Case inventory, scoring/split protocol, audit sampling rule, report outline and quantified full-run capacity decision exist. Slow or inaccessible suites remain explicit scope risks rather than being replaced silently.

days.title: Independently check labels and development runs
days.steps: Verify chart questions and labels against images, benchmark evidence mappings, units/periods and duplicate-source split leakage. Check Likhit index integrity and source coverage. Run development cases only, log outputs and identify parser/retrieval/model/math defects. Require 50 checked chart cases or declare the exact shortfall before freeze.
days.done: Independently checked gold/source manifests, unchanged splits, development results and concrete defect reproductions exist. No held-out answer is used for tuning.

days.title: Complete integration controls and experiment scaffold
days.steps: Accept the repaired combined code and prove shared pre-top-k eligibility, explicit failed-stage semantics, canonical C-F boundaries and truthful complete context. Implement any missing common retrieval/control and versioned experiment scaffold required by the next owners; distinguish A/B representations and real model assets from configuration. Save tests, development success/failure traces, exact interfaces and unresolved gates. Verify cited arithmetic and typed premise failures against actual included context.
days.done: Exact revision, repair and limitation matrix, configured checks, typed failure/context traces and a usable common runner/control scaffold are handed to Likhit. Mandatory missing inputs prevent full freeze.
days.course_concept: Typed input predicates, transformer failure semantics and controlled ablations
dependency_dates: historical through-November-8 handoffs and authorized repair at its actual revision

days.title: Expand supported corpus and build matched representations
days.steps: Recover declared source assets by verified identity/hash, implement supported wider HTML/PDF parsing with source fixtures and explicit unsupported-layout failures, and reconcile five Apple/five Microsoft/ten-company requirements. Build matched A fixed-overlap/flattened-table, B section-aware and C cell/parent representations with common pinned BGE/exact FAISS and stable source-equivalent identities. Preserve the accepted Apple package. Save new source/cell/index candidates for Ujjwal's independent audit and draft methods from real artifacts.
days.done: Reproducible source/parse/index coverage ledger, matched A/B/C artifacts and rejection fixtures exist, with exact raw/parsed/candidate/independently accepted counts. Missing assets/layouts or coverage stay mandatory shortfalls; no automatic source approval.
days.course_concept: Source-grounded representation, transformer embeddings and identity preservation

days.title: Connect application benchmark runner and measured capacity
days.steps: Connect full per-session Gradio narrative/cell/chart/math/source/status flow to accepted APIs. Complete and verify versioned FinQA/TAT-QA/FinanceBench open150 loaders and source-equivalent candidate universes plus resumable A-G/RAGAS and separate Llama runner wiring; official gold stays outside prompts. Verify actual Gemma/cross-encoder/tokenizer/evaluator assets and measure intended-machine cold/warm generation/evaluator throughput, memory and capacity through November 17. Test two sessions and meaningful errors; save a real backup walkthrough. Reconcile benchmark operation requirements with the restricted calculator and implement required safe typed operations or record exact incompatible cases.
days.done: Runnable UI and loader/runner commands, exact case/variant inventory, real-versus-injected tests, model/config/hardware evidence and quantified generation/RAGAS capacity decision or exact blockers reach Ujjwal.
days.course_concept: Explainable AI, leakage-free experiment execution and runtime measurement

days.title: Independently approve inputs freeze controls and launch full runs
days.steps: Independently inspect source/index identities, benchmark mappings and all fifty chart question/caption decisions against original images and sources, recording label authors and hash-bound accept/reject evidence without self-approval. Preserve 15 development/35 held-out image groups. Validate development behavior, complete case/exclusion inventory, scoring controls and measured capacity. Freeze accepted code/data/model/prompt/calculator/token/five-passage/random settings plus stratified fifty-output sampling rule, then launch or resume complete Gemma A-G, RAGAS and separately labelled Llama jobs. Retain failures and exact incomplete scope.
days.done: Independent input decisions, frozen manifest, full eligible case/variant ledger, predeclared audit sample and actual resumable job/output records exist. Missing mandatory approvals, corpus, runnable stages or capacity cause explicit partial/blocked status, never substituted fourteen-case smoke completion.
days.course_concept: Independent label validity, controlled experiments and grounded vision

days.title: Audit outputs compute metrics and finalize report and slides
days.steps: Reconcile frozen completed/running/failed outputs and reproduce normalized numerical/narrative/retrieval/RAGAS/latency metrics with paired confidence intervals and failure/exclusion denominators. Independently audit the predeclared fifty-output sample only where labels were not self-authored; record exact included context, original-source judgments, disagreements and author exclusions for Sudhansh. Complete the written report, exactly six slides, contribution/AI-use/source records, methods integration and final backup demo from actual evidence. Continue immutable jobs without settings changes.
days.done: Evidence-backed report and six-slide draft, metric inputs/results, independent audit decisions and exact unfinished/self-authored-label cases plus release inventory exist. Missing outputs or mandatory scope are explicit.
days.course_concept: Independent faithfulness, uncertainty, hypothesis assessment and accountability
dependency_dates: completed eligible outputs from frozen run ledger

days.title: Verify clean release finish independent exclusions and submit
days.steps: Restore data/index and restart the exact release in a clean prepared environment; verify provider/model/config identities, CI, DVC/MLflow and real success/failure paths. Independently finish audit exclusions from Pavan while rejecting self-approval of Sudhansh-authored labels. Reconcile actual full results and fifty-output audit, report, exactly six slides, AI-use/contributions/sources and backup demo. Freeze one code/data/model/config/archive manifest, verify files open, submit by November 17 and retain acknowledgement; state incomplete scope honestly.
days.done: One runnable hash-bound package, final complete/partial requirement ledger, independent audit count, report/six slides/demo and verified submission acknowledgement exist. Missing outputs and mandatory gates cannot be certified complete.
days.course_concept: Reproducible AI, independent verification and accountable release
dependency_dates: full outputs and actual submission route/cutoff
